# SUTTON CONSERVATION COMMISSION

## Workshop Meeting Minutes

August 25, 2026

Approved [signature]

Present in person: W. Wence, M. McGovern, T. Thompson, J. Marran, A. Cyganiewicz, B. Faneuf -consultant

Unavailable: J. Duval

Workshop Meeting called to order at 3:10 pm.

Discussion was had on roles of agent vs. consultant. Board agreed to split from the Town of Douglas and keep an internal clerk role/entry level agent to be able to grow in role to pick up on responsibilities of in-house agent. Discussion over roles, fees, budget. Board agreed to keeping consultant for the time and putting consultant role out to bid. M. McGovern left at approximately 4pm, A. Cyganiewicz left at approximately 4:30. B.Faneuf arrived around 4:40. Meeting adjourned at 5 pm.
